newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 97-98 insurance premiums seen up -watchdog.
newsitem.headline: Polish 97-98 insurance premiums seen up -watchdog.

text.p: Polish State Insurance Supervision Office, the sector's regulator, said on Wednesday that collected premiums should rise by 21 percent in 1997 and by 22 percent in 1998 from eight billion zlotys last year.
"We expect that in 1997 there will be a growth in premiums of 21 percent and in 1998 of 22 percent," Danuta Walcerz said at a financial-banking forum in the western city of Szczecin.
Walcerz said she expected the life insurance share in Poland's overall insurance market to rise to 51 percent this year, to 62 percent next year and 81 percent in 2000, from 30 percent in 1996.
